summary: Younger job seekers and those without a college degree more often say friends and family were their best route.
realLife: The same survey found these groups more likely to rank friends or family first, while college graduates and older seekers leaned on professional contacts.
sources: Pew Research Center, The Internet and Job Seeking (2015 survey report): https://www.pewresearch.org/internet/2015/11/19/1-the-internet-and-job-seeking/
inGame: Person's age and schooling on their record choose which tie to ask; the job-lost call is the carrier.
